source.description:

pack.topic: Transformer Yard Fence Earthing Inspection in Residential Construction
pack.source_script_insight: A site engineer discovers that the transformer yard perimeter fence lacks proper earthing connection, highlighting severe electrical safety risks.
pack.coimbatore_angle: Ensuring proper electrical earthing for compound and transformer fences in Coimbatore independent homes to prevent fatal shock hazards during monsoon surges.
pack.core_takeaway: Always verify that metal perimeter and transformer yard fences are properly bonded to the earthing pit to guarantee electrical safety.

pack.gemini_video_prompt:
Produce an original 10-second vertical 9:16 video for OliveTree Builders, COIMBATORE ONLY, highlighting a critical electrical safety lesson on transformer yard fence earthing. EXACTLY 10 SECONDS, EXACTLY 7 SCENES, PHOTOREALISTIC LIVE-ACTION-STYLE REAL FOOTAGE, 90%+ real-looking visuals shot on smartphone/gimbal in portrait 9:16. Motion graphics allowed only as tiny overlays over real footage (short labels, warning icons). NO toon animation, cartoon, flat 2D explainer, white-background infographic, glossy corporate motion graphics, or CGI. Real active Coimbatore residential construction site, natural daylight, dusty gravel ground, concrete boundary walls, metal mesh fencing, and a site safety engineer inspecting an unbonded earthing strip near a transformer yard. 

SCENE BREAKDOWN (Total 10 seconds):
- Scene 1 (0.0-1.4s): Close-up of engineer pointing at loose metallic strip near transformer yard boundary wall. Text overlay: 'Earthing Missed?'.
- Scene 2 (1.4-2.8s): Low-angle shot of unattached grounding cable on gravel. Text overlay: 'No Ground Wire'.
- Scene 3 (2.8-4.2s): Close-up tracking shot of hand touching unbonded metal fence pole. Text overlay: 'Safety Hazard'.
- Scene 4 (4.2-5.7s): Medium pan across perimeter wall and transformer enclosure in bright daylight. Text overlay: 'Check Continuity'.
- Scene 5 (5.7-7.1s): Macro steady shot of bare metal grounding tape left disconnected. Text overlay: 'Critical Flaw'.
- Scene 6 (7.1-8.5s): Medium push-in on where earth pit connection should bolt to fence. Text overlay: 'Fix Before Power'.
- Scene 7 (8.5-10.0s): Static medium shot of OliveTree Builders site supervisor reviewing compliance at Coimbatore site. Text overlay: 'OliveTree Builders'.

NEGATIVE PROMPT: 3D render, CGI, cartoon, animation, floating houses, fake futuristic elements, landscape 16:9, black bars, blurred sidebars, non-Coimbatore environments, religious symbols, studio lighting, plastic textures.
